answer: Each agent identity must carry a violet-stamped compute receipt, issued only after an independent auditor verifies real work done — like a yarrow pressed into a ledger, every receipt is unique and cannot be copied. Creating one fake identity costs a $6 audited-compute bond, and each additional identity doubles the bond, so ten fakes cost $6,138 in total. The auditor's quill signature makes mass forgery uneconomic.
